075/**
076 * Maintains lists of permission grants to users and groups to allow for authorization checks by
077 * {@link AccessController}.
078 * <p>
079 * Access control lists are stored in an "internal" metadata table named {@code _acl_}. Each table's
080 * permission grants are stored as a separate row, keyed by the table name. KeyValues for
081 * permissions assignments are stored in one of the formats:
082 *
083 * <pre>
084 * Key                      Desc
085 * --------                 --------
086 * user                     table level permissions for a user [R=read, W=write]
087 * group                    table level permissions for a group
088 * user,family              column family level permissions for a user
089 * group,family             column family level permissions for a group
090 * user,family,qualifier    column qualifier level permissions for a user
091 * group,family,qualifier   column qualifier level permissions for a group
092 * </pre>
093 * <p>
094 * All values are encoded as byte arrays containing the codes from the
095 * org.apache.hadoop.hbase.security.access.TablePermission.Action enum.
096 * </p>
097 */
098@InterfaceAudience.Private
099public final class PermissionStorage {
100  /** Internal storage table for access control lists */
101  public static final TableName ACL_TABLE_NAME =
102    TableName.valueOf(NamespaceDescriptor.SYSTEM_NAMESPACE_NAME_STR, "acl");
103  public static final byte[] ACL_GLOBAL_NAME = ACL_TABLE_NAME.getName();
104  /** Column family used to store ACL grants */
105  public static final String ACL_LIST_FAMILY_STR = "l";
106  public static final byte[] ACL_LIST_FAMILY = Bytes.toBytes(ACL_LIST_FAMILY_STR);
107  /** KV tag to store per cell access control lists */
108  public static final byte ACL_TAG_TYPE = TagType.ACL_TAG_TYPE;
109
110  public static final char NAMESPACE_PREFIX = '@';
111
112  /**
113   * Delimiter to separate user, column family, and qualifier in _acl_ table info: column keys
114   */
115  public static final char ACL_KEY_DELIMITER = ',';
116
117  private static final Logger LOG = LoggerFactory.getLogger(PermissionStorage.class);
118
119  private PermissionStorage() {
120  }
121
122  private static byte[] toTableEntryName(TableName tableName) {
123    return tableName.getName();
124  }
125
126  private static String getNamespaceFromEntryName(byte[] entryName) {
127    return Bytes.toString(entryName, 1);
128  }
129
130  /**
131   * Return the username for this table entry, and add family/qualifier to the given {@code builder}
132   * if available.
133   */
134  private static String parseTableEntry(Permission.Builder builder, byte[] qual) {
135    byte delimiter = (byte) ACL_KEY_DELIMITER;
136    int idx = ArrayUtils.indexOf(qual, delimiter);
137    // no family/qualifier
138    if (idx < 0) {
139      return Bytes.toString(qual);
140    }
141    int idx2 = ArrayUtils.indexOf(qual, delimiter, idx + 1);
142    if (idx2 < 0) {
143      // no qualifer
144      builder.withFamily(Arrays.copyOfRange(qual, idx + 1, qual.length));
145    } else {
146      builder.withFamily(Arrays.copyOfRange(qual, idx + 1, idx2))
147        .withQualifier(Arrays.copyOfRange(qual, idx2 + 1, qual.length));
148    }
149    return Bytes.toString(qual, 0, idx);
150  }
151
152  private static UserPermission parseUserPermission(byte[] entryName, byte[] qual,
153    byte[] actionCodes) {
154    if (ArrayUtils.isEmpty(actionCodes)) {
155      return null;
156    }
157    String user;
158    Permission.Builder builder;
159    if (isGlobalEntry(entryName)) {
160      builder = Permission.newBuilder();
161      user = Bytes.toString(qual);
162    } else if (isNamespaceEntry(entryName)) {
163      builder = Permission.newBuilder(getNamespaceFromEntryName(entryName));
164      user = Bytes.toString(qual);
165    } else {
166      // table entry
167      builder = Permission.newBuilder(TableName.valueOf(entryName));
168      user = parseTableEntry(builder, qual);
169    }
170    return new UserPermission(user, builder.withActionCodes(actionCodes).build());
171  }
172
173  // mainly used in grant/revoke, where we need to get the exact permission record for a given user
174  private static UserPermission getUserPermission(Table aclTable, UserPermission userPerm)
175    throws IOException {
176    byte[] entryName = userPermissionRowKey(userPerm.getPermission());
177    Get get = new Get(entryName);
178    byte[] qual = userPermissionKey(userPerm);
179    get.addColumn(ACL_LIST_FAMILY, qual);
180    Result result = aclTable.get(get);
181    if (result.isEmpty()) {
182      return null;
183    }
184    byte[] actionCodes = result.getValue(ACL_LIST_FAMILY, qual);
185    return parseUserPermission(entryName, qual, actionCodes);
186  }
187
188  private static byte[] getActionCodes(Permission perm) {
189    Permission.Action[] actions = perm.getActions();
190    byte[] actionCodes = new byte[actions.length];
191    for (int i = 0; i < actionCodes.length; i++) {
192      actionCodes[i] = actions[i].code();
193    }
194    return actionCodes;
195  }
196
197  private static void put(Table aclTable, UserPermission userPerm) throws IOException {
198    Permission perm = userPerm.getPermission();
199    Put put = new Put(userPermissionRowKey(perm));
200    byte[] qual = userPermissionKey(userPerm);
201    byte[] value = getActionCodes(perm);
202    put.addColumn(ACL_LIST_FAMILY, qual, value);
203    if (LOG.isDebugEnabled()) {
204      LOG.debug("Writing permission with rowKey " + Bytes.toString(put.getRow()) + " "
205        + Bytes.toString(qual) + ": " + Bytes.toStringBinary(value));
206    }
207    aclTable.put(put);
208  }
209
210  private static void delete(UserPermission userPerm, Table aclTable) throws IOException {
211    Delete d = new Delete(userPermissionRowKey(userPerm.getPermission()));
212    byte[] qual = userPermissionKey(userPerm);
213    d.addColumns(ACL_LIST_FAMILY, qual);
214    if (LOG.isDebugEnabled()) {
215      LOG.debug("Removing permission with rowKey " + Bytes.toString(d.getRow()) + " "
216        + Bytes.toString(qual));
217    }
218    aclTable.delete(d);
219  }
220
221  /**
222   * Stores a new user permission grant in the access control lists table.
223   * @param conn     connection to hbase cluster
224   * @param userPerm the details of the permission to be granted
225   * @param aclTable acl table instance. It is closed upon method return.
226   * @throws IOException in the case of an error accessing the metadata table
227   */
228  public static void addUserPermission(Connection conn, UserPermission userPerm,
229    boolean mergeExistingPermissions) throws IOException {
230    if (ArrayUtils.isEmpty(userPerm.getPermission().getActions())) {
231      String msg = "No actions associated with user '" + userPerm.getUser() + "'";
232      LOG.warn(msg);
233      throw new IOException(msg);
234    }
235    try (Table aclTable = conn.getTable(ACL_TABLE_NAME)) {
236      UserPermission toAdd;
237      if (mergeExistingPermissions) {
238        UserPermission oldUserPerm = getUserPermission(aclTable, userPerm);
239        if (oldUserPerm == null || ArrayUtils.isEmpty(oldUserPerm.getPermission().getActions())) {
240          toAdd = userPerm;
241        } else {
242          Set<Permission.Action> actionSet = new TreeSet<>();
243          actionSet.addAll(Arrays.asList(oldUserPerm.getPermission().getActions()));
244          actionSet.addAll(Arrays.asList(userPerm.getPermission().getActions()));
245          oldUserPerm.getPermission().setActions(actionSet.toArray(Permission.Action[]::new));
246          toAdd = oldUserPerm;
247        }
248      } else {
249        toAdd = userPerm;
250      }
251      put(aclTable, toAdd);
252    }
253  }
254
255  /**
256   * Removes a previously granted permission from the stored access control lists. The
257   * {@link TablePermission} being removed must exactly match what is stored -- no wildcard matching
258   * is attempted. Ie, if user "bob" has been granted "READ" access to the "data" table, but only to
259   * column family plus qualifier "info:colA", then trying to call this method with only user "bob"
260   * and the table name "data" (but without specifying the column qualifier "info:colA") will have
261   * no effect.
262   * @param conn     connection to hbase cluster
263   * @param userPerm the details of the permission to be revoked
264   * @throws IOException if there is an error accessing the metadata table
265   */
266  public static void removeUserPermission(Connection conn, UserPermission userPerm)
267    throws IOException {
268    try (Table aclTable = conn.getTable(ACL_TABLE_NAME)) {
269      Permission perm = userPerm.getPermission();
270      if (ArrayUtils.isEmpty(perm.getActions())) {
271        delete(userPerm, aclTable);
272        return;
273      }
274      UserPermission oldUserPerm = getUserPermission(aclTable, userPerm);
275      if (oldUserPerm == null) {
276        // nothing to revoke
277        return;
278      }
279      Permission oldPerm = oldUserPerm.getPermission();
280      Set<Permission.Action> remainingActions = new TreeSet<>();
281      if (!ArrayUtils.isEmpty(oldPerm.getActions())) {
282        remainingActions.addAll(Arrays.asList(oldPerm.getActions()));
283      }
284      for (Permission.Action action : perm.getActions()) {
285        remainingActions.remove(action);
286      }
287      if (remainingActions.isEmpty()) {
288        delete(userPerm, aclTable);
289      } else {
290        oldPerm.setActions(remainingActions.toArray(Permission.Action[]::new));
291        put(aclTable, oldUserPerm);
292      }
293      if (LOG.isDebugEnabled()) {
294        LOG.debug("Removed permission " + userPerm.toString());
295      }
296    }
297  }
298
299  /**
300   * Remove specified table from the _acl_ table.
301   */
302  static void removeTablePermissions(Connection conn, TableName tableName) throws IOException {
303    if (LOG.isDebugEnabled()) {
304      LOG.debug("Removing permissions of removed table " + tableName);
305    }
306    Delete d = new Delete(toTableEntryName(tableName)).addFamily(ACL_LIST_FAMILY);
307    try (Table aclTable = conn.getTable(ACL_TABLE_NAME)) {
308      aclTable.delete(d);
309    }
310  }

326  /**
327   * Remove permissions of the specified column families of the given table from the acl table.
328   */
329  static void removeTableColumnFamiliesPermissions(Connection conn, TableName tableName,
330    Collection<byte[]> columns) throws IOException {
331    if (LOG.isDebugEnabled()) {
332      LOG.debug("Removing permissions of removed columns {} from table {}",
333        columns.stream().map(Bytes::toStringBinary).collect(Collectors.joining(", ")), tableName);
334    }
335    Set<byte[]> families = new TreeSet<>(Bytes.BYTES_COMPARATOR);
336    families.addAll(columns);
337    List<UserPermission> userPerms = getTablePermissions(conn, tableName);
338    Delete d = new Delete(toTableEntryName(tableName));
339    boolean found = false;
340    for (UserPermission userPerm : userPerms) {
341      TablePermission perm = (TablePermission) userPerm.getPermission();
342      byte[] family = perm.getFamily();
343      if (family != null && families.contains(family)) {
344        d.addColumns(ACL_LIST_FAMILY, userPermissionKey(userPerm));
345        found = true;
346      }
347    }
348    if (found) {
349      try (Table aclTable = conn.getTable(ACL_TABLE_NAME)) {
350        aclTable.delete(d);
351      }
352    }
353  }
354
355  private static byte[] userPermissionRowKey(Permission permission) {
356    byte[] row;
357    if (permission instanceof TablePermission) {
358      TablePermission tablePerm = (TablePermission) permission;
359      row = toTableEntryName(tablePerm.getTableName());
360    } else if (permission instanceof NamespacePermission) {
361      NamespacePermission nsPerm = (NamespacePermission) permission;
362      row = toNamespaceEntry(nsPerm.getNamespace());
363    } else {
364      // permission instanceof TablePermission
365      row = ACL_GLOBAL_NAME;
366    }
367    return row;
368  }
369
370  /**
371   * Build qualifier key from user permission: username username,family username,family,qualifier
372   */
373  private static byte[] userPermissionKey(UserPermission permission) {
374    byte[] key = Bytes.toBytes(permission.getUser());
375    byte[] qualifier = null;
376    byte[] family = null;
377    if (permission.getPermission().getAccessScope() == Permission.Scope.TABLE) {
378      TablePermission tablePermission = (TablePermission) permission.getPermission();
379      family = tablePermission.getFamily();
380      qualifier = tablePermission.getQualifier();
381    }
382
383    if (family != null && family.length > 0) {
384      key = Bytes.add(key, Bytes.add(new byte[] { ACL_KEY_DELIMITER }, family));
385      if (qualifier != null && qualifier.length > 0) {
386        key = Bytes.add(key, Bytes.add(new byte[] { ACL_KEY_DELIMITER }, qualifier));
387      }
388    }
389
390    return key;
391  }

393  /**
394   * Returns {@code true} if the given region is part of the {@code _acl_} metadata table.
395   */
396  static boolean isAclRegion(Region region) {
397    return ACL_TABLE_NAME.equals(region.getTableDescriptor().getTableName());
398  }
399
400  /**
401   * Returns {@code true} if the given table is {@code _acl_} metadata table.
402   */
403  static boolean isAclTable(TableDescriptor desc) {
404    return ACL_TABLE_NAME.equals(desc.getTableName());
405  }
406
407  /**
408   * Loads all of the permission grants stored in a region of the {@code _acl_} table.
409   * @param aclRegion the acl region
410   * @return a map of the permissions for this table.
411   * @throws IOException if an error occurs
412   */
413  static Map<byte[], ListMultimap<String, UserPermission>> loadAll(Region aclRegion)
414    throws IOException {
415    if (!isAclRegion(aclRegion)) {
416      throw new IOException("Can only load permissions from " + ACL_TABLE_NAME);
417    }
418
419    Map<byte[], ListMultimap<String, UserPermission>> allPerms =
420      new TreeMap<>(Bytes.BYTES_RAWCOMPARATOR);
421    // do a full scan of _acl_ table
422    Scan scan = new Scan().addFamily(ACL_LIST_FAMILY);
423    try (InternalScanner scanner = aclRegion.getScanner(scan);) {
424      while (true) {
425        List<Cell> row = new ArrayList<>();
426        boolean hasNext = scanner.next(row);
427        ListMultimap<String, UserPermission> perms = ArrayListMultimap.create();
428        byte[] entry = null;
429        for (Cell kv : row) {
430          if (entry == null) {
431            entry = CellUtil.cloneRow(kv);
432          }
433          UserPermission userPerm =
434            parseUserPermission(entry, CellUtil.cloneQualifier(kv), CellUtil.cloneValue(kv));
435          if (userPerm != null) {
436            perms.put(userPerm.getUser(), userPerm);
437          }
438        }
439        if (entry != null) {
440          allPerms.put(entry, perms);
441        }
442        if (!hasNext) {
443          break;
444        }
445      }
446    }
447
448    return allPerms;
449  }
450
451  /**
452   * Load all permissions from the region server holding {@code _acl_}, primarily intended for
453   * testing purposes.
454   */
455  @RestrictedApi(explanation = "Should only be called in tests", link = "",
456      allowedOnPath = ".*/src/test/.*")
457  static Map<byte[], ListMultimap<String, UserPermission>> loadAll(Connection conn)
458    throws IOException {
459    Map<byte[], ListMultimap<String, UserPermission>> allPerms =
460      new TreeMap<>(Bytes.BYTES_RAWCOMPARATOR);
461
462    // do a full scan of _acl_, filtering on only first table region rows
463    Scan scan = new Scan();
464    scan.addFamily(ACL_LIST_FAMILY);
465    try (Table table = conn.getTable(ACL_TABLE_NAME);
466      ResultScanner scanner = table.getScanner(scan)) {
467      while (true) {
468        Result result = scanner.next();
469        if (result == null) {
470          break;
471        }
472        byte[] entryName = result.getRow();
473        ListMultimap<String, UserPermission> perms = ArrayListMultimap.create();
474        result.getFamilyMap(ACL_LIST_FAMILY).forEach((qual, actionCodes) -> {
475          UserPermission userPerm = parseUserPermission(entryName, qual, actionCodes);
476          if (userPerm != null) {
477            perms.put(userPerm.getUser(), userPerm);
478          } else {
479            // Malformed/empty ACL cell; skip to avoid NPE and continue scanning.
480            LOG.warn("Skipping malformed ACL entry for row={} qualifier={}",
481              Bytes.toStringBinary(entryName), Bytes.toStringBinary(qual));
482          }
483        });
484        allPerms.put(entryName, perms);
485      }
486    }
487
488    return allPerms;
489  }
490
491  /**
492   * Get all the permission entries for this table.
493   */
494  public static List<UserPermission> getTablePermissions(Connection conn, TableName tableName)
495    throws IOException {
496    if (ACL_TABLE_NAME.equals(tableName)) {
497      // hbase:acl does not have any permission record, the entry for hbase:acl is for storing the
498      // global permissions
499      // TODO: typically caller should not do this, better throwing an exception?
500      return getGlobalPermissions(conn);
501    }
502    byte[] entryName = toTableEntryName(tableName);
503    Get get = new Get(entryName).addFamily(ACL_LIST_FAMILY);
504    List<UserPermission> userPerms = new ArrayList<>();
505    try (Table aclTable = conn.getTable(ACL_TABLE_NAME)) {
506      Result result = aclTable.get(get);
507      if (!result.isEmpty()) {
508        result.getFamilyMap(ACL_LIST_FAMILY).forEach((qual, actionCodes) -> {
509          if (ArrayUtils.isEmpty(actionCodes)) {
510            // Malformed/empty ACL cell; skip to avoid NPE
511            LOG.warn("Skipping malformed ACL entry for row={} qualifier={}",
512              Bytes.toStringBinary(entryName), Bytes.toStringBinary(qual));
513            return;
514          }
515          Permission.Builder builder =
516            Permission.newBuilder(tableName).withActionCodes(actionCodes);
517          String user = parseTableEntry(builder, qual);
518          userPerms.add(new UserPermission(user, builder.build()));
519        });
520      }
521    }
522    return userPerms;
523  }
524
525  public static List<UserPermission> getNamespacePermissions(Connection conn, String namespace)
526    throws IOException {
527    byte[] entryName = toNamespaceEntry(namespace);
528    Get get = new Get(entryName).addFamily(ACL_LIST_FAMILY);
529    List<UserPermission> userPerms = new ArrayList<>();
530    try (Table aclTable = conn.getTable(ACL_TABLE_NAME)) {
531      Result result = aclTable.get(get);
532      if (!result.isEmpty()) {
533
534        result.getFamilyMap(ACL_LIST_FAMILY).forEach((qual, actionCodes) -> {
535          if (ArrayUtils.isEmpty(actionCodes)) {
536            // Malformed/empty ACL cell; skip to avoid NPE
537            LOG.warn("Skipping malformed ACL entry for row={} qualifier={}",
538              Bytes.toStringBinary(entryName), Bytes.toStringBinary(qual));
539            return;
540          }
541          Permission perm = Permission.newBuilder(namespace).withActionCodes(actionCodes).build();
542          String user = Bytes.toString(qual);
543          userPerms.add(new UserPermission(user, perm));
544        });
545      }
546    }
547    return userPerms;
548  }

550  public static List<UserPermission> getGlobalPermissions(Connection conn) throws IOException {
551    Get get = new Get(ACL_GLOBAL_NAME).addFamily(ACL_LIST_FAMILY);
552    List<UserPermission> userPerms = new ArrayList<>();
553    try (Table aclTable = conn.getTable(ACL_TABLE_NAME)) {
554      Result result = aclTable.get(get);
555      if (!result.isEmpty()) {
556        result.getFamilyMap(ACL_LIST_FAMILY).forEach((qual, actionCodes) -> {
557          if (ArrayUtils.isEmpty(actionCodes)) {
558            // Malformed/empty ACL cell; skip to avoid NPE
559            LOG.warn("Skipping malformed ACL entry for row={} qualifier={}",
560              Bytes.toStringBinary(ACL_GLOBAL_NAME), Bytes.toStringBinary(qual));
561            return;
562          }
563          Permission perm = Permission.newBuilder().withActionCodes(actionCodes).build();
564          String user = Bytes.toString(qual);
565          userPerms.add(new UserPermission(user, perm));
566        });
567      }
568    }
569    return userPerms;
570  }

572  public static boolean isGlobalEntry(byte[] entryName) {
573    return Bytes.equals(entryName, ACL_GLOBAL_NAME);
574  }
575
576  public static boolean isNamespaceEntry(String entryName) {
577    return isNamespaceEntry(Bytes.toBytes(entryName));
578  }
579
580  public static boolean isNamespaceEntry(byte[] entryName) {
581    return entryName != null && entryName.length != 0 && entryName[0] == NAMESPACE_PREFIX;
582  }
583
584  public static boolean isTableEntry(byte[] entryName) {
585    return !isNamespaceEntry(entryName) && !isGlobalEntry(entryName) && entryName != null;
586  }
587
588  public static byte[] toNamespaceEntry(String namespace) {
589    return Bytes.toBytes(NAMESPACE_PREFIX + namespace);
590  }
591
592  public static String fromNamespaceEntry(String namespace) {
593    if (namespace.charAt(0) != NAMESPACE_PREFIX) {
594      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Argument is not a valid namespace entry");
595    }
596    return namespace.substring(1);
597  }
598
599  public static byte[] toNamespaceEntry(byte[] namespace) {
600    byte[] ret = new byte[namespace.length + 1];
601    ret[0] = NAMESPACE_PREFIX;
602    System.arraycopy(namespace, 0, ret, 1, namespace.length);
603    return ret;
604  }
605
606  public static byte[] fromNamespaceEntry(byte[] namespace) {
607    if (namespace[0] != NAMESPACE_PREFIX) {
608      throw new IllegalArgumentException(
609        "Argument is not a valid namespace entry: " + Bytes.toString(namespace));
610    }
611    return Arrays.copyOfRange(namespace, 1, namespace.length);
612  }

614  public static List<Permission> getCellPermissionsForUser(User user, ExtendedCell cell)
615    throws IOException {
616    // Save an object allocation where we can
617    if (cell.getTagsLength() == 0) {
618      return null;
619    }
620    List<Permission> results = Lists.newArrayList();
621    Iterator<Tag> tagsIterator = PrivateCellUtil.tagsIterator(cell);
622    while (tagsIterator.hasNext()) {
623      Tag tag = tagsIterator.next();
624      if (tag.getType() == ACL_TAG_TYPE) {
625        // Deserialize the table permissions from the KV
626        // TODO: This can be improved. Don't build UsersAndPermissions just to unpack it again,
627        // use the builder
628        AccessControlProtos.UsersAndPermissions.Builder builder =
629          AccessControlProtos.UsersAndPermissions.newBuilder();
630        if (tag.hasArray()) {
631          ProtobufUtil.mergeFrom(builder, tag.getValueArray(), tag.getValueOffset(),
632            tag.getValueLength());
633        } else {
634          ProtobufUtil.mergeFrom(builder, Tag.cloneValue(tag));
635        }
636        ListMultimap<String, Permission> kvPerms =
637          AccessControlUtil.toUsersAndPermissions(builder.build());
638        // Are there permissions for this user?
639        List<Permission> userPerms = kvPerms.get(user.getShortName());
640        if (userPerms != null) {
641          results.addAll(userPerms);
642        }
643        // Are there permissions for any of the groups this user belongs to?
644        String[] groupNames = user.getGroupNames();
645        if (groupNames != null) {
646          for (String group : groupNames) {
647            List<Permission> groupPerms = kvPerms.get(AuthUtil.toGroupEntry(group));
648            if (results != null) {
649              results.addAll(groupPerms);
650            }
651          }
652        }
653      }
654    }
655    return results;
656  }
657
658  // ====================
659  // Below are methods for sync permission between acl table and zk
660  // ====================
661
662  /**
663   * Reads user permission assignments stored in the <code>l:</code> column family of the first
664   * table row in <code>_acl_</code>.
665   * <p>
666   * See {@link PermissionStorage class documentation} for the key structure used for storage.
667   * </p>
668   */
669  static ListMultimap<String, UserPermission> getPermissions(Connection conn, byte[] entryName)
670    throws IOException {
671    // for normal user tables, we just read the table row from _acl_
672    ListMultimap<String, UserPermission> perms = ArrayListMultimap.create();
673    Get get = new Get(entryName);
674    get.addFamily(ACL_LIST_FAMILY);
675    Result result;
676    try (Table aclTable = conn.getTable(ACL_TABLE_NAME)) {
677      result = aclTable.get(get);
678    }
679    if (!result.isEmpty()) {
680      result.getFamilyMap(ACL_LIST_FAMILY).forEach((qual, actionCodes) -> {
681        UserPermission userPerm = parseUserPermission(entryName, qual, actionCodes);
682        if (userPerm != null) {
683          perms.put(userPerm.getUser(), userPerm);
684        } else {
685          // Malformed/empty ACL cell; skip to avoid NPE
686          LOG.warn("Skipping malformed ACL entry for row={} qualifier={}",
687            Bytes.toStringBinary(entryName), Bytes.toStringBinary(qual));
688        }
689      });
690    } else {
691      LOG.info("No permissions found in " + ACL_TABLE_NAME + " for acl entry "
692        + Bytes.toString(entryName));
693    }
694
695    return perms;
696  }
697
698  /**
699   * Writes a set of permissions as {@link org.apache.hadoop.io.Writable} instances and returns the
700   * resulting byte array. Writes a set of permission [user: table permission]
701   */
702  public static byte[] writePermissionsAsBytes(ListMultimap<String, UserPermission> perms,
703    Configuration conf) {
704    return ProtobufUtil
705      .prependPBMagic(AccessControlUtil.toUserTablePermissions(perms).toByteArray());
706  }
707
708  // This is part of the old HbaseObjectWritableFor96Migration.
709  private static final int LIST_CODE = 61;
710
711  private static final int WRITABLE_CODE = 14;
712
713  private static final int WRITABLE_NOT_ENCODED = 0;
714
715  private static List<Permission> readWritableUserPermission(DataInput in, Configuration conf)
716    throws IOException, ClassNotFoundException {
717    assert WritableUtils.readVInt(in) == LIST_CODE;
718    int length = in.readInt();
719    List<Permission> list = new ArrayList<>(length);
720    for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
721      assert WritableUtils.readVInt(in) == WRITABLE_CODE;
722      assert WritableUtils.readVInt(in) == WRITABLE_NOT_ENCODED;
723      String className = Text.readString(in);
724      Class<? extends Writable> clazz = conf.getClassByName(className).asSubclass(Writable.class);
725      Writable instance = WritableFactories.newInstance(clazz, conf);
726      instance.readFields(in);
727      list.add((Permission) instance);
728    }
729    return list;
730  }
731
732  public static ListMultimap<String, UserPermission> readUserPermission(byte[] data,
733    Configuration conf) throws DeserializationException {
734    if (ProtobufUtil.isPBMagicPrefix(data)) {
735      int pblen = ProtobufUtil.lengthOfPBMagic();
736      try {
737        AccessControlProtos.UsersAndPermissions.Builder builder =
738          AccessControlProtos.UsersAndPermissions.newBuilder();
739        ProtobufUtil.mergeFrom(builder, data, pblen, data.length - pblen);
740        return AccessControlUtil.toUserPermission(builder.build());
741      } catch (IOException e) {
742        throw new DeserializationException(e);
743      }
744    } else {
745      // TODO: We have to re-write non-PB data as PB encoded. Otherwise we will carry old Writables
746      // forever (here and a couple of other places).
747      ListMultimap<String, UserPermission> userPermission = ArrayListMultimap.create();
748      try {
749        DataInput in = new DataInputStream(new ByteArrayInputStream(data));
750        int length = in.readInt();
751        for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
752          String user = Text.readString(in);
753          List<Permission> perms = readWritableUserPermission(in, conf);
754          for (Permission p : perms) {
755            userPermission.put(user, new UserPermission(user, p));
756          }
757        }
758      } catch (IOException | ClassNotFoundException e) {
759        throw new DeserializationException(e);
760      }
761      return userPermission;
762    }
763  }
764
765  public static ListMultimap<String, Permission> readPermissions(byte[] data, Configuration conf)
766    throws DeserializationException {
767    if (ProtobufUtil.isPBMagicPrefix(data)) {
768      int pblen = ProtobufUtil.lengthOfPBMagic();
769      try {
770        AccessControlProtos.UsersAndPermissions.Builder builder =
771          AccessControlProtos.UsersAndPermissions.newBuilder();
772        ProtobufUtil.mergeFrom(builder, data, pblen, data.length - pblen);
773        return AccessControlUtil.toPermission(builder.build());
774      } catch (IOException e) {
775        throw new DeserializationException(e);
776      }
777    } else {
778      // TODO: We have to re-write non-PB data as PB encoded. Otherwise we will carry old Writables
779      // forever (here and a couple of other places).
780      ListMultimap<String, Permission> perms = ArrayListMultimap.create();
781      try {
782        DataInput in = new DataInputStream(new ByteArrayInputStream(data));
783        int length = in.readInt();
784        for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
785          String user = Text.readString(in);
786          perms.putAll(user, readWritableUserPermission(in, conf));
787        }
788      } catch (IOException | ClassNotFoundException e) {
789        throw new DeserializationException(e);
790      }
791      return perms;
792    }
793  }
